alerts.text: Legacy spreadsheet equations in use: no π in the penetration exponent, no slip in the pressure drop, size distribution set by the range. Use only to check against the spreadsheet.

Clean, uniform, uncharged filter: no electrostatic capture, no dust loading, no particle bounce, one mean fibre diameter. Real membranes with a wide diameter distribution or uneven thickness usually show lower efficiency and lower pressure drop.
Fibre Knudsen number 0.48: slip flow at the fibre. Pressure drop is reduced by a slip factor of 0.65 relative to the continuum value.
Pressure drop is linear in velocity (Darcy flow with slip). Fibre Reynolds number 9.5e-4, far below 1.
